title: Owner: create the voidbrain/ui library repository
goal: The owner decides on the voidbrain/ui repository (name, visibility, how it publishes) for an Angular library
acceptance: The owner chooses: name (voidbrain/ui proposed), visibility, and publishing (GitHub Packages npm or Git tags); Angular library, web components only if a non-Angular consumer appears
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one decision on the options T03 writes down. Not a measurement.
